evals.name: Portfolio Collections & Single Types Schema Scaffolding
evals.prompt: Scaffold a complete Strapi v5 portfolio backend schema declaring Project, Skill, Experience, and Article collections along with Global and About single types.
evals.expected_output: Generates schema.json files adhering to Strapi v5 conventions with draftAndPublish and relational mappings.
assertions: Defines schema.json for Project, Skill, Experience, and Article collection types
Declares Global and About single types for global site settings
Enables draftAndPublish: true on Project and Article collections
Implements many-to-many relation between Project and Skill entities

evals.name: UID Slugs & Blocks Rich Content Architecture
evals.prompt: Configure slug attributes across Strapi v5 collections using UID type and structure article content using the modern Blocks editor.
evals.expected_output: Configures type: uid attached to title/name targetField and declares content using type: blocks.
assertions: Sets slug attributes with type: uid targeting title or name fields
Uses modern type: blocks for rich text content rather than plain text strings
Defines Shared.Seo and Shared.SocialLink reusable components
Ensures slugs are unique and indexed for frontend SPA routing

evals.name: Public Role Permission & Media Storage Guidelines
evals.prompt: Instruct on configuring Public role permissions for frontend consumption and establishing cloud media storage providers.
evals.expected_output: Details granting find/findOne permissions in Strapi Admin and warns against local public/uploads in production.
assertions: Specifies granting find and findOne permissions to Public role in Admin UI
Recommends third-party upload providers (Cloudinary/S3) over local public/uploads
Enforces pnpm package manager for all Strapi plugin installations
Documents the flat REST API response structure of Strapi v5
